reviews.title: One of the best AIO's you can buy!
reviews.comment: be quiet! Pure Loop 2 FX 360mm: Powerful Cooling, Quiet Confidence (with a Few Quirks) Overall Rating: 4.5 out of 5 stars For: Gamers, overclockers, noise-conscious users, high-performance PCs Against: Pricey, bulky for some cases, lack of RGB (if you're into that) Cooling Performance: 5 out of 5 stars The Pure Loop 2 FX 360mm lives up to its name, keeping my overclocked Intel i9-12900K cool and calm even under heavy workloads. The large 360mm radiator and powerful Silent Wings 3 fans efficiently dissipate heat, resulting in impressive temperature drops compared to air coolers. I saw temperatures stay well below thermal throttling even during intense gaming sessions and benchmarks. Noise Level: 5 out of 5 stars This is where the "be quiet!" part truly shines. The Pure Loop 2 FX runs incredibly quiet, even at full speed. The Silent Wings 3 fans generate minimal noise, making it virtually inaudible during everyday tasks and surprisingly quiet even during gaming. This is a huge plus for noise-sensitive users and those looking for a peaceful computing experience. Build Quality and Design: 4.5 out of 5 stars The Pure Loop 2 FX feels premium throughout. The aluminum radiator is solid and well-built, and the hoses are flexible yet durable. The pump also features a sleek LED ring that offers a subtle glow (though no full RGB if you're into that). Installation was straightforward thanks to the included pre-applied thermal paste and clear instructions. The only minor gripe is the size – the 360mm radiator might not fit all cases, so be sure to check compatibility before purchase. Value: 4 out of 5 stars The Pure Loop 2 FX comes at a premium price, which might be a sticking point for budget-conscious builders. However, its exceptional cooling performance, quiet operation, and premium build quality justify the cost for users who prioritize top-notch thermal management and a tranquil computing environment. Things to Consider: Size: As mentioned, the 360mm radiator might not fit all cases. Check compatibility before buying. Price: This is a high-end cooler with a high-end price tag. Consider your budget carefully. No RGB: If you're into flashy builds with lots of RGB lighting, this cooler might not be for you. Final Verdict: The be quiet! Pure Loop 2 FX 360mm is a top-tier CPU liquid cooler that delivers unbeatable cooling performance with incredibly low noise levels. Its premium build quality and ease of installation make it a compelling choice for gamers, overclockers, and anyone who demands the best for their high-performance PC. While the price and size might be dealbreakers for some, the unparalleled cooling and quiet operation make it a worthy investment for those who prioritize thermal excellence and a serene computing experience. Note: This review is based on my own experience using the be quiet! Pure Loop 2 FX 360mm for several weeks. Your results may vary. reviews.title: Like Christmas in my case
reviews.comment: I don't know if this will help anyone else but I was able to fit this in a push configuration intake in an NZXT S340 Elite case. I was only able to get 2 of the screws actually into the radiator itself but it's very secure. Tickled with how it cools my i7-9700k @ 5 GHz. Lights are cool. Mounting was easy. It's very quiet and an awesome upgrade from my hyper 212 air cooler. Make sure to get an argb controller with it if your motherboard is old like mine.

reviews.title: It works great and looks great!
reviews.comment: This AIO is fantastic! It works great and it is beautiful with the three RGB fans. I love the fact that they give you extra radiator coolant and provide a place on the radiator for you to add it for the future. It would have been nice if they would have mounted the fans on the radiator for you, but it's not a big deal. Installation was easy. I install this AIO in a Be Quiet! 900FX Case. It is cooling an AMD Ryzen 5 7600X 3D CPU. It works great and looks great! I love it and I highly recommend this all-in-one cooler.
reviews.author: Kevin Cureton

reviews.title: Great AIO cooler for a very fair price
reviews.comment: Why did you pick this product vs others?: I picked the Be Quiet pure loop 280mm because I needed a two fan AIO cooler for my open air build and this one seemed to be a very fair price from a manufacturer that has gotten decent reviews lately Ease of installation: Overall this was not a difficult installation. I probably would recommend using a pressure plate from thermal grizzly or someone else to prevent board flex, as it did seem possible to over-tighten this design... but if you know what you are doing and use some common sense it isnt really needed. I do not have a pressure plate installed and have even reinstalled after a CPU upgrade and it is working perfectly. The way the pump is positioned on the lines is a little awkward, and I dont necessarily love the look of it as much as bare lines, but it was not an issue for me. Temperature control: I originally installed this on a 9800x3d and it did great. The room this PC is in stays around 70-72F (~21-22c) and the 9800x3d idled at 38c. I have since swapped my CPU to a 9950x3d and it idles very similarly, sometimes a degree or two more. under heavy load like a CPU-z all core stress test I can get the CPU temps to climb into the 80s but never come close to thermal throttling even on a 30minute continuous run. Added Notes: I did not use the included thermal paste, I used thermal grizzly kryonaut extreme. there isnt an issue I know of with the included paste, I just keep the kryonaut extreme on hand and it is a brand I trust. I currently have not PBO enabled on my motherboard, so this likely lowered my thermal needs a small amount while under load, but still the 9950x3d is hitting its all-core boost of 5.1-5.2ghz and max boost of 5.6 to 5.7 without issue while hitting the above thermals. I will be purchasing another of these coolers for a 14700k which eats more power and generates more heat and will update the review at that time, but at the moment I am very impressed with its performance on the 9950x3d.
